headline: Teachers' contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance, Local 930, for 2026 through 2029.
summary: The agenda lists a contract with the Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance, Local 930, for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2029. It also lists two city solicitor communications about pending litigation, which may be discussed in executive session.

TO:  All Members of the Pawtucket City Council

FROM:       Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE:          September 24, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
________________________________ 
 
 
The following joint meetings of the Pawtucket City Council ’s Committee of the Whole , Finance 
Committee, and Committee on Claims and Pending Suits are to be held on Monday, September 28 , 
2026, beginning at 5:30 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Second Floor 
– Room 204, Parking Lot Entrance at 75 Sabin Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
 
2. COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE AND COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS: 
 
• Communication from Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., City Solicitor, to the Honorable Terrence E. 
Mercer, City Council President (Pavano v. City of Pawtucket CA No: PC-2012-3852) 
 
A portion of this meeting may be held in Executive Session pursuant to § 42-46-4 and § 42-46-5 
(A)(2) of the General Laws of the State of Rhode Island regarding pending litigation. 
 
This portion of the meeting is being called by Council President Terrence E. Mercer and Yesenia 
Rubio, Chair, Committee on Claims and Pending Suits.
